format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-alert id="a1" heading="Изменения сохранены" supporting-text="Новая версия уже доступна" action-text="Открыть" action="open-version" status="success" closable></sf-alert>
<sf-alert id="a2" heading="Не удалось сохранить" status="error" closable></sf-alert>

probes.title: the root is a live region: status for success, alert for error, named by the heading

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#a1 .sf-alert'); const b = document.querySelector('#a2 .sf-alert'); return a.getAttribute('role') === 'status' && a.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Изменения сохранены' && b.getAttribute('role') === 'alert'; })()

probes.title: an action button: sf-alert-action {action} once, data only

steps.script: (() => { let seen = null; const el = document.getElementById('a1'); el.addEventListener('sf-alert-action', (e) => { seen = e.detail; }, {once: true}); el.querySelector('[data-alert-action]').click(); return Boolean(seen) && !('alert' in seen) && document.getElementById('a1').isConnected; })()

probes.title: its close button: the request with reason close, then the alert leaves
a page that prevents the request keeps the alert; close() answers refused
title, type (danger) and variant answer; dismiss() calls close()

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('a-old'); const r = el.querySelector('.sf-alert'); return el.getAttribute('heading') === 'Старое имя' && el.status === 'error' && el.appearance === 'outlined' && r.getAttribute('role') === 'alert' && r.textContent.includes('Старое имя'); })()
